case.summary: Customer C08106 reported the $128.33 online transaction 3583227 on 2016-12-29 as unauthorized. The transaction was made from Firefox 47.0, marked as a new device for this account, and the device profile is shared with account C00294. The flagged transaction is over four times the cardholder's median transaction amount of $26.62 across 216 prior transactions, and the episode contains seven additional transactions totaling $384.43 across December 28-30. The card_not_present_new_device pattern triggered at strength 0.57, and all eight similar closed cases in memory were confirmed fraud with no false alarms, while this account also has three prior confirmed card-not-present fraud cases. The assessment fraud probability of 0.77 and the consistent pattern match across historical cases strongly support a fraud verdict. I am highly confident this is fraudulent activity.

sar.narrative: Customer C08106 reported that a $128.33 online purchase on card C08106-K1 made on 2016-12-29 at 01:53:54 was unauthorized. The transaction was made using a device profile (Firefox 47.0) that the identity record marks as new to this account. The flagged transaction is part of an eight-transaction episode spanning 2016-12-28 through 2016-12-30, with a total exposure of $384.43 across online channels and unrecorded billing regions. The cardholder's baseline history shows 216 transactions between 2016-07-06 and 2016-12-30 with a median amount of $26.62, making the flagged transaction more than four times the typical purchase size. The device used for this transaction is shared with account C00294. This account has three prior confirmed card-not-present fraud cases on record. The pattern of card-not-present fraud from a new device matches eight structurally similar closed cases, all of which were confirmed fraud. The assessment assigns a fraud probability of 0.77 based on the new device pattern, though the bank's independent model risk score for the individual flagged transaction is 0.34. The customer's direct dispute of the charge, combined with the pattern match, new device marker, transaction size anomaly, and account history, supports the fraud verdict. The bank created a case, initiated monitoring of connected cards, and filed this report. The suspicious activity total is $384.43, and the bank recommends blocking card C08106-K1.
